annotation.title_clean: Embedding responsible innovation into R&D practices: A case study of socially assistive robot development
annotation.title_en: Embedding responsible innovation into R&D practices: A case study of socially assistive robot development
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Lukkien, D.R.M.; Nap, H.H.; ter Stal, M.; Boon, W.P.C.; Peine, A.; Minkman, M.M.N. et al.
annotation.summary_en: Participatory action research within the GUARDIAN socially assistive robot project, exploring how responsible innovation (anticipation, inclusion, reflexivity, responsiveness) can be embedded in R&D. It identifies four barriers and recommends participatory action research for R&D teams and funders.
key_provisions_or_claims: Participatory action research produced modest, deliberate RI efforts on privacy, control and energy consumption.
Four barriers: lack of action perspective, noncommittal nature of RI, co-design mistaken for RI, limited integration between task groups.
Co-design should be ongoing, not a box-ticking exercise.
Funders should assess feedback loops and support RI in R&D projects.
PAR is recommended to address RI barriers.
